versions.name: Law
versions.description: Trace law from Hammurabi's code to the jury system, sort out civil from criminal cases, sit in on a trial or stage a mock one, and find how someone gets legal help they cannot afford.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
